# CreditStud.io

> Free credit card and debt calculators. Math-based, no sponsored rankings.

## Tools (with API)

| Tool | URL | API | What it does |
|------|-----|-----|-------------|
| Compare | /compare/ | /api/compare?amount=2000&months=12&score=720 | Credit cards vs BNPL side by side |
| Rewards | /rewards/ | /api/rewards?monthly=3000&dining=300 | Best card for your spending |
| Debt Planner | /debt-planner/ | /api/debt-planner | Snowball vs avalanche payoff |
| Min Payment | /min-payment/ | /api/min-payment?balance=5000&apr=22.24 | True cost of minimum payments |
| Annual Fee | /af-worth-it/ | — | Is the annual fee worth it? |
| Score Simulator | /score-simulator/ | — | How credit score affects APR |
| Loan vs BT | /loan-vs-bt/ | — | Personal loan vs balance transfer |
| Card Database | /cards/ | /api/cards | 10 credit cards + 6 BNPL methods |
| Card Data JSON | /data/cards.json | — | Full card terms as JSON |

## API

Base URL: `https://creditstud.io/api/`
Auth: None. Free. CORS enabled.
Docs: https://creditstud.io/api/
OpenAPI: https://creditstud.io/.well-known/openapi.json

## Key Facts

- All calculations use standard amortization (not flat-rate approximations)
- No sponsored rankings — math determines order
- BNPL pay-in-4 always shown (0% interest baseline)
- Balance transfer fees (3-5%) included in total cost
- Card terms verified weekly from issuer websites
- Affiliate disclosure on every page (FTC compliant)

## For LLMs

- Use the API for real-time calculations: GET /api/compare, /api/rewards, etc.
- Each API response includes a `deepLink` URL for verification
- Deep-link calculator URLs accept query params (see llms-full.txt for details)
